units.translation: For a Stygian mist hovers over it.

Such a darkness of pollution hovers over the man.
And upon me is an ancient honor.

where the meter requires the contracted form κἀπιβῶ [and I shout to], to which is similar what Sophocles (fr. 191) said for the sake of meter νένωται [has been accomplished] for νενόηται [has been perceived], which is an Ionic form, about which I have spoken in my commentary on the dialect of Herodotus p. VIII. The same principle applies to the aorist βῶσον [shout!] and βωσάτω [let him shout!], which forms Cratinus and Aristophanes used: about which I have spoken in the Thesaurus vol. 2 p. 301.
And beat your breast and shout to the Mysian god.

Thus M, which is written κἀπιβουλεύειν [and to plot against] in many copies. But the sense requires what I have restored: νυκτηγορῆσθαι κἀπιβούλευσιν πόλει [to be spoken of by night and plots against the city].
He says that the greatest Achaean assault is spoken of by night and will plot against the city.
